description: This file defines a PHP class 'MultipartCopy' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling multipart copy operations in Amazon S3, including initiation, uploading parts, and retrieving source metadata.

classes.name: MultipartCopy
classes.description: Handles multipart copy uploads in S3, managing the upload lifecycle, part creation, and source metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartCopy object, setting source location and configuration.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Alias for uploading, initiates the copy process.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Provides the workflow commands for initiating, uploading parts, and completing the multipart upload.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates upload part commands for the multipart upload.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates the data for each part to be uploaded, including source range and metadata.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from the upload result.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the source object.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source object in bytes.

methods.name: getSourceMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the source object's metadata.

methods.name: fetchSourceMetadata
methods.description: Fetches the source object's metadata via a head request.

methods.name: getInputSource
methods.description: Converts the source input into a standardized, URL-decoded string starting with a slash if necessary.
